{{Top|leg}}
'''Sureseal Patches''' were emergency systems that could be used to seal suit leaks on [[GTU]]'s [[AV-1 power armor|AV-1]] series of [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]]. Each suit carried five Sureseal Patches.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
